capabilities: Suggest notes and aliases while typing
Link to folders and reveal them in the file explorer
extras: Part of a set of plugins by the same author, alongside GTD Tasks, Kalendae, and LeapFrog. Folder links reveal the folder in the file explorer rather than creating an empty note.
intentEvidence: removes the need to type [[ before creating a wikilink
problem: Typing [[ before every wikilink is slow, and mistyping the trigger leaves you with no link suggestions at all.

relations.evidence: By default Littera Nexa replaces it while a note matches what you type

summary: Link autocomplete that suggests notes, aliases, and folders as you type, creating wikilinks without needing to type [[.
